# Syncopx

Syncopx is a free floating desktop AI assistant for Windows 10/11 64-bit.
It talks and listens (voice conversation), sees the screen (OCR + control),
manages files and documents, runs programs and terminal commands, and keeps
notes, to-dos and chat history on the user's own PC.

- Download (ZIP, no admin, no signup): https://syncopx.vercel.app/#download
- How installing works: https://syncopx.vercel.app/#install
- AI providers (bring your own key, or local Ollama): https://syncopx.vercel.app/#providers
- FAQ: https://syncopx.vercel.app/#faq
- Terms: https://syncopx.vercel.app/terms.html
- Privacy: https://syncopx.vercel.app/privacy.html
- Current version metadata (file, size, SHA-256): https://syncopx.vercel.app/downloads/version.json

Keys are encrypted on the user's PC with Windows DPAPI. No accounts, no tracking.
